## File: facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spatial_engine/utils/scannet_utils/handler/info_handler.py

Prompts

```
['build a SceneInfoHandler to load ScanNet scene data from a pickle file and query scene metadata', 'create a function that projects 3D points to 2D image coordinates using camera intrinsic and extrinsic matrices', 'test the check_point_visibility method to verify if 3D points are visible in a specific camera image', 'refactor the get_extrinsic_matrix method to handle invalid matrices with inf or nan values more robustly', 'summarize the VisibilityInfoHandler class that maps images to visible points and points to visible images', 'filter a list of image paths by sharpness using the Laplacian variance threshold', 'calculate the sharpness score of an image using the Laplacian variance method', 'convert 3D bounding boxes with center and dimensions to their eight corner coordinates', 'calculate the 3D Intersection over Union of two axis-aligned bounding boxes', 'project a 2D mask to 3D world coordinates using depth and camera matrices']
```

Usage

```
{'build_scene_info_handler': 'build a SceneInfoHandler to load ScanNet scene data from a pickle file and query scene metadata', 'create_3d_to_2d_projection': 'create a function that projects 3D points to 2D image coordinates using camera intrinsic and extrinsic matrices', 'test_point_visibility': 'test the check_point_visibility method to verify if 3D points are visible in a specific camera image', 'refactor_extrinsic_matrix_retrieval': 'refactor the get_extrinsic_matrix method to handle invalid matrices with inf or nan values more robustly', 'summarize_visibility_info_handler': 'summarize the VisibilityInfoHandler class that maps images to visible points and points to visible images'}
```
